fact: In 2024 Benin registered 9,847 refugees (20,357 registered of about 25,000 at end 2024) and the ABPC registered 2,605 IDPs in Alibori and 3,200 in Atacora; the WURI project plans to register refugees in the national register (RNPP) in 2025.
title: Benin Response Plan Report (Gulf of Guinea Joint Response Plan 2024)
